content: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 is current (Rust-powered, released Jan 2025, v4 line). For a tiny 10-page branded site, multiple practical writeups (incl. Julia Evans classic and CSS-vs-Tailwind builds) conclude hand-written CSS beats Tailwind below a complexity threshold: no build step, no class noise in hand-authored German content templates, full design control. Tailwind shines when teams iterate fast on large UIs; overkill here.
